responses.text: 自由意味着一种在独立意志下做出选择的权利。现实环境下，受限于当时环境和历史局限性，并不存在绝对的自由，本质上，都只是戴着镣铐跳舞。
正义是一种价值判断，符合大多数的利益的事业就是正义的事业，但事实上有可能是错误的。因为很大程度上正义的确立依赖于社会统治者需要，普通大众容易被错误的引导。
责任意味着对行为的结果承担责任，也是社会对成年人的要求。因此，在接受任务和做决定前，应该认真评估，避免不负责任的行为。
成功随社会的背景的不同，可能会有不同的定义。对个人来说，如：外在认可和内在接受不一致。短期可能成功，但从长期看不一定是成功。

freedom means you have access to information you need, any place you want to visit, sufficient time being with your family or alone even you have a job and also clean and affordable food and fresh air. Concepts including privacy, less documents, affordability, accessibility
Justice means things done in a right manner. the most Ideas or Concepts: procedure, equality, female rights,environmental protection, animal rights
something you are obliged to. Most important Concepts: providing the family, complete your duty at work, taking care of yourself.
home is a place where you enjoy your time with children, parents. you feel so much relieved being with family at home. Concepts like mate, children, parents.
you fullfil your life functioning yourself to the most you get some forturn or reputation in the meanwhile. Most important concepts: benefits,personal fulfillment, reputation, career development
Freedom is understanding the laws of life and being able to choose for yourself how to live within those boundaries. Freedom is relative.
Justice is a fair and righteous result. This can apply in a court case or in life. How we treat others or how they treat us.
Responsibility means to know your role or place in a situation and successful carry out your duties. This can apply in the workplace or even in the family.
A home can refer to a literal house, a place or country you feel you belong to. It can also mean a figurative place where you feel safe.
Success means to have a goal or objective and do your place to complete that goal. Even if you do not succeed, the fact you have tried is a measure of success. This can apply in any aspect of life.
The power to exercise free will within God's commandments
Legal or religious verdict via universal criteria
Home is where my loved ones are
